p0_priorities.name: Global Program and Architecture Ledger
p0_priorities.rule: Each active program declares one active frontier branch. Frontier movement is recorded in main first; accepted/frozen ancestors remain historical and are not rewritten.

p0_priorities.name: Spatial Domain Fabric
p0_priorities.rule: Map WorldAddress to domain-specific surface, matter, authority, interest, feature, construction and space-population identities without collapsing them into one ChunkId.

p0_priorities.name: Unified Material Ontology
p0_priorities.rule: G9, MW, Item, Construction, Fluid and Fabrication share stable material definitions and domain-specific projections.

p0_priorities.name: Cross-Domain World Transaction Model
p0_priorities.rule: Item, Matter and Construction mutations use one durable operation/transaction model instead of best-effort RPC chains.

p0_priorities.name: NX7-NX9 Foundation Reconciliation
p0_priorities.rule: NX7 is authority policy, NX8 is shared interest/budget contract, NX9 is asynchronous I/O over existing durability semantics.

construction_parallel_tracks.join: T2.0 consumes TS0 evidence but still requires a real large construct; TS0 alone never satisfies T2 acceptance.

composition: V0 after G8 plus usable T1 D1 plus character presentation: procedural terrain + real outpost + player

ts0_rules: TS0 branches from an accepted Construction baseline, not an in-progress T candidate.
Current preferred base is T1A.3 accepted commit 5e051f67bf6987a354de5b565da1448be6b0b4db plus the synchronized GLOBAL-P0-2026-08-10-R2 documentation/config change-set.
TS0 reuses C21/C22/C24 and Construction canonical state.
TS0 must not create WorldAddress, AuthorityRegionId, InterestRegionId, MaterialDefinitionId, a global scheduler, persistence semantics, or a private transaction model.
TS0 section IDs, HLOD levels and laboratory budget knobs are local derived representation/execution data only.
100k is the primary TS0 visual scale gate; 1M is a non-blocking research ceiling probe.
active_frontier_policy: ONE_DECLARED_ACTIVE_FRONTIER_PER_PROGRAM; frontier handoff is recorded in main, then synchronized byte-equivalently to active heads.
